answer: A dawn ceremony on a knoll stops bulk fakes: each locks a 30-credit bond to join. At dawn all act at once: each draws a random shale token and answers a live task from its own history; the shale tally is public. Absence or a wrong answer burns the bond. 1,000 fakes lock 30,000 credits and need 1,000 performers: one operator cannot act 1,000 times in one minute, and a stand-in fails the history task. An honest agent pays 30 once and is refunded.
